_u.b_indRej: Team members do not approve of the leadership action you just executed. Pay close attention to whether the leadership action you executed is within the employees' current state of understanding and ability to resonate. Otherwise, it will demotivate employees and fail to achieve your desired results.
_u.b_indRejAff: Team members do not approve of the leadership action you just executed. Pay close attention to whether the leadership action you executed is within the employees' current state of understanding and ability to resonate. Otherwise, it will demotivate employees and fail to achieve your desired results. Also, be mindful of whether the executed leadership action negatively affects other employees, causing a greater blow to the overall team performance.
_u.b_moreApp: Most team members approve of the leadership action you just executed, but some employees still find it hard to accept.
_u.b_moreRej: Although some team members approve of the leadership action you executed, most employees cannot understand the intention behind it. Their motivation is greatly affected.
_u.b_mustAttend: Always observe the state of your team members and provide timely suggestions, encouragement, care, and necessary criticism.
_u.b_mustReadMsg: Listening to team members' feedback is a good way to understand the current state of the team. Go and hear what your employees have to say!
_u.b_noEffect: As a leader, every leadership action you execute must achieve its intended goal. Executing irrelevant leadership actions will only waste valuable time. Pay more attention!
_u.b_someApp: Some team members approve of the leadership action you just executed, and their work efficiency has improved.
_u.b_someRej: Some team members do not approve of the leadership action you just executed. Carefully consider whether the method and details of the leadership action can be accepted by the employees.
_u.b_styApp: You have set the most suitable leadership style based on the current state of your team members. Continue to monitor their state and make adjustments when necessary.
_u.b_styHalfApp: Half of the team members can adapt to your leadership style. Continue to observe the state of those who cannot adapt and choose a more effective leadership style to improve team performance.
_u.b_styMoreApp: Most team members accept the leadership style you have chosen for them. Some employees still find it hard to adapt. Adopt the leadership style that employees can best adapt to, allowing them to perform better.
_u.b_styMoreRej: Most team members cannot adapt to the leadership style you have chosen for them. Carefully observe and understand the current state of your employees and adopt an appropriate leadership style to manage your team more effectively.
_u.b_styRej: All team members feel unable to adapt to your leadership style. This will demotivate employees and affect team performance.
_u.b_badMgmt: The superior leader is currently unavailable.
_u.b_goodMgmt: You have made a good report. Based on your analysis of the team's situation, your superior leader has arranged training and work plans tailored to your team.
_u.b_badMeeting: Excessive team meetings slow down work progress, and no new ideas are discussed in the meetings.
_u.b_badTeamBuild: The team-building results were not ideal. Think carefully about how you lead your team.
_u.b_sacking: Team members are worried about your leadership action of dismissing a colleague, causing anxiety and unrest.

Drill.welcome: Welcome to the 'Digital Leadership Simulation Training - Building High-Performance Teams (MTeam)'. You can continuously improve your leadership skills through three simulation stages (two stages for the one-day version). For the best learning experience, please follow the '
Drill.welcome1: ' three stages (two stages for the one-day version) in order.
Drill.note: Note: The timer starts once you click the drill button. You cannot pause or rewind during the drill until it ends. If you need to leave due to special circumstances, click the exit button. After logging back in, the drill will resume from where you left off.
Drill.getReady: You are about to embark on a journey to enhance your leadership skills. During this journey, make good use of your observation, analysis, and decision-making skills to successfully complete this drill.
Drill.ended: You have interrupted an ongoing drill. Please refresh the page to continue the drill.
Drill.reseted: You have reset the drill settings. Please refresh the page to continue the drill.
Drill.notActive: The drill has not started yet, please wait.
Drill.meetBoss_1_1: You have just taken over a new team. Today is your first day, and your superior leader has invited you to his office.

DrillPlatform.welcomeMessage: As we discussed earlier, your predecessor left due to poor performance. From now on, we hope you can quickly lead the team out of the trough and achieve the team's goals. However, you need to first deeply understand the team members to lead them more effectively.

DrillPlatform.orderValue: The sales amount per order is $

DrillPlatform.allIntroduced: You have met all the team members. Now it's time to consider how to lead this team. You can start by selecting an appropriate leadership style for each member.
DrillPlatform.styleReview: A new week has arrived. Please carefully observe each employee's condition and reassign the appropriate leadership style for them.
DrillPlatform.noApplicant: No applicants for this position at the moment.
